Criterion_1_IndependentDetection.statement: Both opening and closing delimiters are independently detected as scalable mathematical delimiters.
Criterion_1_IndependentDetection.metric: recall_count >= 2 for tall delimiter candidates on Page 8

Criterion_2_CorrectPairing.statement: Opening and closing delimiters are correctly paired without cross-association.

Criterion_3_ColumnRowOrdering.statement: All six numeric columns and six rows are preserved in exact spatial and index order.

Criterion_4_EllipsisPreservation.statement: Horizontal ellipsis (···) is preserved in Row 0; vertical continuation (⋮) is preserved in Row 6.

Criterion_5_BoundaryIsolation.statement: The following expression 'A_0(z) = e^z / (1+z)' and prose remain strictly outside the matrix enclosure.

Criterion_6_ASTPreservation.statement: Resulting matrix AST preserves pmatrix environment and correct 7x6 effective grid shape.

Criterion_7_MathematicalFidelity.statement: Source-to-reconstruction comparison confirms zero residual against reference cell values.

NEG_001_MismatchedDelimiters.description: Pairing of opening parenthesis with closing bracket [) or (] must be rejected.

NEG_002_MissingClosingDelimiter.description: Opening delimiter without a matching partner must not produce a speculative matrix.
NEG_002_MissingClosingDelimiter.expected_outcome: REJECTED (unpaired delimiter preserved without false enclosure)

NEG_003_AdjacentMatrixCrossAssociation.description: Delimiters from adjacent side-by-side matrices must not be cross-paired.
NEG_003_AdjacentMatrixCrossAssociation.expected_outcome: REJECTED (intervening delimiter guard enforces separate pairing)

NEG_004_TallNonMathGraphic.description: Tall vertical ruling or non-mathematical vertical crop must not be classified as delimiter.
